messages:
alex: Heads-up — I merged a small TS SDK change that adds an `affinityKey` option to request calls to influence shard selection (helps sharded caches). Wanted to flag quota/routing implications before we cut the SDK release.

mira: can you paste the snippet? curious about the shape and name.

alex: sure — usage is tiny:
```ts
// optional 2nd arg is runtimeOptions
client.generate({ model: 'redwood-base', prompt }, { affinityKey: 'user-123' })
```

sam: from router side: affinityKey is hashed and used to pick a shard for routing and cache locality. current quotas are evaluated by org_id + route. affinity alone doesn't change billing, but it *can* concentrate traffic onto a single shard which may trigger per-shard throttles.

jen: product question — will customers see any change in Console? eg per-route dashboards or cost by affinity? we probably need to surface this or it will confuse SEs.

patrick: compatibility worry: old SDKs will not send affinityKey so traffic distribution will change once clients upgrade. that could cause noisy neighbors. do we require server-side opt-in?

sam: good point — server can default to ignoring affinity for quota checks, but honor it for caching/routing. that would avoid quota circumvention while still getting locality benefits.

alex: that sounds like a safe default. is there a flag we can expose to customers who explicitly want quota partitioning by affinity?

jen: yes — we could add a per-customer setting in Console: "Honor affinity for quota routing" with warning text. UX can show a tooltip and note potential for uneven usage.

patrick: also need a migration note in the TS changelog: explain behavioral change and recommend canary.

sam: I'll add a server-side switch `honorAffinityForQuota: boolean` default false. server will log when affinity is present but ignored so we can audit.

alex: will we add a header so non-SDK clients can set it? e.g. `x-redwood-affinity: user-123`?

sam: yes — the SDK writes that header. routers already pick it up. just ensure we validate length/charset to avoid hash collisions.

deploy-bot: deploy queued for canary cluster (canary-2) — rolling starting in 10m.

ci-bot: TS SDK build 552 passed unit tests, e2e failing on auth mock (flaky) — opened ticket DEVEX-412.

mira: for changelog wording: something like: "add optional affinityKey to influence routing/cache locality. Does not affect quota unless Console option enabled." short and clear.

alex: thanks. next steps: sam implements server flag + logging, jen wires Console toggle + tooltip, patrick drafts release notes + migration guidance, mira updates changelog paragraph. we'll hold SDK GA until canary is stable.

jen: noted — I'll make a small Console card and assign to UX. :white_check_mark:

patrick: tagging @support to prep a KB article if customers ask.

alex: thanks everyone — will bump the PR with the note and wait for canary results.
